title: Uruguayan Turnip Hash with a Twist
description: A delicious and keto-friendly twist on the classic Uruguayan turnip hash, incorporating the freshness of citrusy ingredients.

ingredients.name: Uruguayan chorizo
ingredients.notes: make sure to choose a keto-friendly option

instructions: Chop the turnips into 1-inch cubes and roast them in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
While the turnips are roasting, cook the hash browns in a skillet over medium heat until crispy.
Add the citrusy zest, Uruguayan chorizo, and fresh parsley to the skillet and stir to combine.
Once the turnips are done, add them to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Enjoy your keto-friendly Uruguayan turnip hash!
